notes.title: Aristotle the Axolotl Plush available now from Makeship!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39044929/f7f4e8d4a08db72ea8dea638239ca78825bfbb53.jpg[/img]

From the world of Billie Bust Up and right into your (hopefully) loving arms, it’s Aristotle the Axolotl! Cute, pink, and basically a genius. They can teach you anything you want to learn! Magic, cooking, magic cooking! Even math, I guess. They’re wonderful company and dressed to impress with a tiny purple cape, and only sometimes will they cry about their lost love and angsty past!

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/aristotle-the-axolotl-plush]Get yours now from Makeship![/url]
